content.text: {"reachable": false, "rationale": "The target is not reachable. Blocking containerHost:execution makes tokenCache:credentialAccess unreachable, because containerHost is its only parent. Without tokenCache, apiToken:authenticate, ssoLogin:authenticate and jumpHost:lateralMovement are also lost. Blocking mailClient:execution removes rdpLogin:authenticate and vpnSession:authenticate, since both are AND steps that need it. With vpnSession gone, monitoringHost:lateralMovement is lost, and with browserStore also blocked, fileServer:lateralMovement is lost. Checking each parent of crownData:exfiltrate: (1) codeRepo:collection fails because fileServer is unreachable, localAdmin is an AND step that needs ssoLogin, and hypervisor is an AND step that needs rdpLogin. (2) mailArchive:collection fails because printServer has lost all three of its parents (tokenCache, vpnSession, apiToken). (3) shareMount:collection fails because serviceAccount and secretsManager are both AND steps that need monitoringHost. (4) dbReplica:collection fails because both monitoringHost and hypervisor are unreachable. No parent of crownData:exfiltrate can be reached."}
